meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给这个安装接上 Dial：装好后它拥有一个真实电话号码，可收发短信、用 AI 接打语音电话。安装会复制 Dial 适配器、装好 dial CLI、设置来电问候语，并和你的手机做一次配对。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 添加 Dial 通道、配一个能收发短信和接听 AI 语音电话的真实号码时触发。

say.text: 帮我接上 Dial，给我的 agent 配一个电话号码
say.note: 开始走安装与号码配置流程

say.text: 把这条 Dial 线路的来电问候语改成我的版本
say.note: 更新打进该号码的 AI 提示词

say.text: 这条线只允许我自己的手机发短信
say.note: 把线上策略设为 strict，其他人被拒

howto.what_en: Wires this install to Dial: it gets a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Setup copies the adapter, installs the dial CLI, sets an inbound call greeting, and pairs your phone once.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add the Dial channel — a real number that can send and receive texts and answer AI voice calls.

say_en.text: Hook up Dial and give my agent a phone number
Change the inbound greeting on my Dial line
say_en.note: updates the AI prompt for calls in

say_en.text: Only my own phone may text this line
say_en.note: sets the line policy to strict
